parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Caller-supplied key, 1-128 printable ASCII characters (a UUID minted once per LOGICAL submit; a retry reuses it, a new user action mints a new one). Required on every POST: a missing key is `400 idempotency-key-required`, a malformed one `400 idempotency-key-invalid`. The key is global to the service: a retry with the same method, path and body replays the stored answer (status, body and `Location`) with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` and runs nothing; the same key with a different method, path or body is `409 idempotency-key-reused`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The package id, as returned by `POST /tasks/{id}/package-seals`.
